layers.name: Skull / scalp
layers.description: Bone, scalp and other tissue outside the brain.

layers.name: Gray matter
layers.description: The brain's outer layer (cortex), where most nerve cell bodies are.

layers.name: CSF / ventricles
layers.description: Fluid around the brain and in the ventricles (fluid-filled spaces inside the brain).

layers.name: Suspected lesion
layers.description: Area that looks different from surrounding tissue. Not a diagnosis.
